contact_edits.before: Bruce Dow, mohawk-pated, seems to be having a good time going through the sleazy motions -- we've long gone past mere seediness -- but he's at his best in a straightforward despairing number like I Don't Care Much, which he sings as if he actually does, very much. To be honest, some of the emcee's numbers, especially Two Ladies, are feeble even as written, and the production doesn't do much for them. It's the real-life characters, about to be engulfed in terror, and they make it tremendous. - Cabaret runs until Oct. 24. For tickets and information call 1-800-567-1600 or visit stratfordfestival.ca.
